constraint: Alternative must explicitly address the failure mechanism.
why_required: The observed failure is not a model-capacity issue; it is task/label/metric semantics.
minimum_evidence_needed: A section explaining target semantics, expected signal, and why MAE/RMSE/Spearman conflict should not recur.

constraint: Alternative must define no-training smoke tests and baseline controls before any first-pass model.

minimum_evidence_needed: Target audit, fold audit, baseline control, metric sanity, leakage guard.

constraint: Alternative must define stop/archive criteria before execution.
why_required: The project must avoid broad search on an ill-posed task.
minimum_evidence_needed: Quantitative criteria for no actionable signal, metric conflict, and fold/subject artifact.
forbidden_in_next_step: open-ended exploration without predeclared stop criteria
